landing.hero.title: Fresh produce, direct from verified Ugandan farms
landing.hero.subtitle: TundaGula connects smallholder farmers and commercial growers with wholesale buyers, restaurants, and households. Fair prices, verified farmers, guaranteed delivery.
landing.features.price.title: Prices you can see
landing.features.price.desc: Real-time market reference prices next to every listing so you always know you're getting a fair deal.
landing.features.verify.title: Verified farmers
landing.features.verify.desc: National ID and phone verified sellers. No ghost listings or fake brokers.
landing.features.preorder.title: Harvest pre-orders
landing.features.preorder.desc: Reserve crops before harvest with a small deposit. Guaranteed produce at locked-in prices.
landing.features.delivery.title: Transparent delivery
landing.features.delivery.desc: From bodaboda to 10-ton trucks, choose the right delivery mode for your order volume.
landing.steps.1.title: Register and get verified
landing.steps.1.desc: Sign up in 60 seconds with your phone number and National ID.
landing.steps.2.title: List or order produce
landing.steps.2.desc: Farmers list their harvest; buyers place immediate orders or pre-orders.
landing.steps.3.title: Pay safely on delivery
landing.steps.3.desc: Escrow mobile money payment holds funds safely until produce is inspected.
